facts.claim: Godot PR #62444 '[3.x] Faster queue free' exists and is merged (merged 2023-01-10 into the 3.x branch, merge commit 1ee7c5a62c2a51a168e6355e6a6b667cd2d9bbb8)

The PR diff is 67 added and 5 deleted lines across 3 files (doc/classes/Node.xml, scene/main/scene_tree.cpp, scene/main/scene_tree.h); the core change replaces the List-based delete queue with a LocalVector of ObjectID plus child_list_id and sorts it in _flush_delete_queue
The PR author reports deleting 50,000 nodes dropped from about 137,017 ms to 422 ms
The PR documents that deletion order is not guaranteed, so the change alters the observable deletion order (reverse child order), which conflicts with the seed's gate of identical deletion order
A later 4.x merged change to the same deletion path (the 'later 4.x deletion code' the reference relies on) exists
The seed's smoke_build exercised a Godot build and Godot's test suite

v1.kill_reason: No strong reference is obtainable. The verifiable reference is the 67+/5- merged PR, which the seed's own identical-deletion-order gate conflicts with (the PR reorders deletions and documents that order as non-guaranteed, so a valid alternative fails). The 'later 4.x deletion code' was not found. Secondary risk: K10, since the verified scope is one data-structure change in one file.

Band.why: Frontier agents likely get the PR-level gain within hours; the extra levers are unmeasured; weaker model micro-gains is plausible

Build.why: Godot template build is tens of minutes, but writing a deterministic equivalence harness plus the reference costs days

Fit.why: Headless C++ build fits 8 cores and 16 GB; memory for linking not yet measured

Hor.why: The verified scope is one data-structure swap; a 4 h tier is not justified by the work

Multi.why: Levers (queue, group removal, child bookkeeping) all touch the same ~70 lines of scene_tree.cpp; few independent buckets

Nov.why: Highest neighbour cosine 0.361 among the same-batch operations; no crowded overlap

Real.why: Merged upstream PR in a 118k-star MIT repo, but the verifiable change is only ~70 lines

Ref.why: The PR is a 67-line change whose order semantics conflict with the gate; the later 4.x code was not found, so the reference cannot be shown to be strong or complete

Seal.why: Harness and hidden shapes can be sealed, but the reference diff is public in history and recallable in outline

Surf.why: Scenario generator over four tree shapes gives an executable oracle, but the harness is not written; surface is a few shapes times sizes

spike_plan.kill_if: The PR shows no reorder, or the order differs run-to-run so the gate cannot be deterministic, or no 4.x later change exists to justify a reference larger than the PR
spike_plan.pass_if: Base build works in under 40 minutes, the driver is deterministic across 3 runs, and the PR gives at least 10x on the flat shape with a visible order difference from base
steps: Clone godotengine/godot in a throwaway container with network; check out the parent of merge commit 1ee7c5a62c2a51a168e6355e6a6b667cd2d9bbb8 on the 3.x line (base) and record its commit hash.
Build the base headless with scons (platform=linuxbsd target=template_release tools=no, -j8) and time it.

Write a small GDScript or C++ driver that creates 50k nodes in flat, deep, group-heavy and signal-heavy shapes, then calls queue_free and flushes; log deletion order, notifications and signals to a file.
Repeat with the PR cherry-picked (edc85d2) and diff the logs; this tests whether the PR changes the order the seed's gate requires to be identical.
Measure median wall-clock over 5 runs per shape for base and PR.
Search the 4.x branch history for any later change to the deletion path; record the result either way.

v1.summary: Godot PR #62444 is real, merged, MIT, and small (67 added and 5 deleted lines across 3 files, which the seed's claimed reference cannot exceed without unverified 4.x code). The seed is killed as K5 because the gate pins deletion order to a reordering the PR itself calls non-guaranteed, and the smoke probe ran a Python placeholder rather than a Godot build.
